newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya coffee prices stronger at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya coffee prices stronger at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices were stronger on Tuesday at the weekly coffee auction following advances in the international market, auction officials said.
Grade Cs averaged $261.38 per 50-kg (110 lb) from $234.68, while grade PBs averaged $272.88 from $240.48. Grade AAs averaged $273.68 from $242.77.
"The prices were also higher on good general demand from overseas roasters," a trader said.
Out of 45,723 60-kg bags of coffee on offer, the coffee board of Kenya said it sold 45,700 bags, compared to 40,480 bags sold last week.
